wholePhysicalScope: The named Dutch building-register outline mapped in OpenStreetMap controls placement, the curved base of the visible dome and the general public exterior roofline. Smaller exterior masses are generalized.
lodDetails: Four levels retain the pale dome and industrial roofline. Near levels define concrete, roof flashing and cladding.
limitations: Approximate silhouette, divided roof forms and cladding, based on the mapped outer perimeter and public written descriptions.
The model covers the visible dome and connected major masses, with simplified window bands and a graded foundation.
Photographs, other premises and detailed site features were excluded.
